newsitem.title: EU: Reuters Long-Term EU Diary for Oct 2 - Nov 12 1997.
newsitem.headline: Reuters Long-Term EU Diary for Oct 2 - Nov 12 1997.

text.p: THURSDAY, OCTOBER 2
LUXEMBOURG - EU telecoms ministers meet. No agenda yet available.
BRUSSELS - European Parliament holds mini session (second of two days). Provisional agenda includes advance debate on the EU jobs summit.

VIENNA - European Intermodal Association (EIA) holds conference on "Europe towards intermodal transport" (0930/0730 GMT) (To October 3). Speakers include: EU Commissioner Neil Kinnock. Venue: Hilton Hotel. Contact: EIA (322) 514 5654.
FRIDAY, OCTOBER 3
ECHTERNACH, Luxembourg - EU internal market ministers hold informal meeting and structured dialogue with Central and East European countries (To October 4). No agenda yet available.

STRASBOURG (NEW ITEM) - European Dairy Association holds World Diary Forum on regional dairy market and policies developments. Speakers include European Agriculture Commissioner Franz Fischler. Contact: Dr. A.J. van de Ven, EDA (322) 549 5040.
MONDAY, OCTOBER 6
LUXEMBOURG - EU foreign ministers meet (To October 7). No agenda yet available.
TUESDAY, OCTOBER 7
LUXEMBOURG - EU employment and social affairs ministers meet. No agenda yet available.

BRUSSELS - Aeronautica holds conference on "The European air transport conference" (To October 8). The theme of the conference is globalisation and in this context it will look closely at airline profitability, alliances, competition and safety. Venue: Sheraton Hotel and Towers. Contact: Aeronautica (44) 181 893 3795.
THURSDAY, OCTOBER 9
LUXEMBOURG - EU transport ministers meet and hold structured dialogue with Central and East European countries. No agenda yet available.
MONDORF, Luxembourg - EU justice and home affairs hold informal meeting (To October 10).

BRUSSELS - European Association of Fresh Produce Importers (CIMO) holds conference on "Internalisation of international trade: towards free trade and balanced markets" (0930/0730 GMT) (To Oct 10). Venue: Sheraton Hotel. Contact: CIMA (322) 771 3635.
BONN - Committee of the Regions holds seminar on "Cross-border and inter-regional cooperation". Contact: Committee of the Regions (322) 282 2155.
SUNDAY, OCTOBER 12
SPAIN - European Commission sponsors all-star football tournament as part of European Year against Racism, with teams captained by Diego Maradona, Eric Cantona and George Weah.
MONDAY, OCTOBER 13
LUXEMBOURG - EU finance ministers meet. No agenda yet available.
WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 15

BRUSSELS - Cogen Europe holds fourth annual conference on "Limiting climate change - The role of decentralised congeneration" (To October 16). Venue: Sheraton Hotel. Contact: Cogen Europe (322) 772 8290.
THURSDAY, OCTOBER 16
LUXEMBOURG - EU environment ministers meet (or October 26). No agenda yet available.
MONDAY, OCTOBER 20
LUXEMBOURG - EU agriculture ministers meet (To October 21). No agenda yet available.
STRASBOURG - European Parliament holds plenary session (To October 24).
WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 22
STRASBOURG - European Parliament holds debate on the state of the EU, European Commission work programme for 1998.

AALBORG, Denmark - Euro Communication '97 conference "Electronic government - as a driving force for the information society" (0900/0700 GMT) (To October 24). Venue: Congress and Culture Centre. Contact: Congress and Culture Centre (45) 99 35 5555.

WASHINGTON (NEW ITEM) - Hart Publications Inc. holds World Conference on "Refining Technology, New Fuels and Public Policy" (To October 24). Venue: J.W. Marriott Hotel. Contact: Paul Caplan (00713) 993 9320, ext 217.
THURSDAY, OCTOBER 23
ATHENS - EU Committee of the Regions holds seminar on "Combined transport". Contact: Committee of the Regions (322) 282 2155.
SATURDAY, OCTOBER 25
MONDORF, Luxembourg - EU foreign ministers hold informal meeting (To October 26).
WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 29
BRUSSELS - EU Economic and Social Committee (ECOSOC) holds plenary session (To October 30).
LONDON - Agra Europe holds conference on "Food & agribusiness in Central and Eastern Europe" (To Oct 30). Contact: Agra Europe (44) 1892 511 807.
THURSDAY, OCTOBER 30
LUXEMBOURG - EU fisheries ministers meet. No agenda yet available.
LUXEMBOURG - Luxembourg EU Presidency hosts high-level meeting in the framework of preparations for the second Asia-Europe Meeting (ASEM) summit to be held in London in April 1998.
MARRAKESH - Euro-Mediterranean ministerial meeting on industrial cooperation (To October 31).
MONDAY, NOVEMBER 3
BRUSSELS - EU consumers ministers meet. No agenda yet available.
BRUSSELS - European Commission and the European Parliament hold joint conference on "Food law and food policy" (To Nov 4).
WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 5
BRUSSELS - European Parliament holds mini session (To November 6).
THURSDAY, NOVEMBER 6
LIBREVILLE, Gabon - African, Caribbean, Pacific heads of state and government hold summit (To November 7).

BRUSSELS - European Society of Transport Institutes (ESTI) and European Commission Directorates-General VII (Transport) and XIII (Information Technology) hold conference on "The role of transport research for policy development in the European Union" (To November 7). Venue: ESTI, rue Archimede 5, Bte 11, 1000 Brussels. Contact: Laetitia Hoste (ESTI) (322) 230 0514.
MONDAY, NOVEMBER 10
BRUSSELS - EU research ministers meet. No agenda yet available.
BRUSSELS - EU foreign ministers meet. No agenda yet available.
WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 12

BRUSSELS - Eurocommerce holds eighth European day of commerce on "Europe, commerce and consumers - Meeting consumer expectations" (To November 13). Panels will discuss consumer information on the euro, electronic commerce and environment-friendly consumption. Participants include European Parliament President Jose Maria Gil Robles, European Commissioners Brittan and Bonino. Venue: Hilton Hotel. Contact: Eurocommerce (322) 230 6689.
TOULOUSE, France - European People's Party (EPP) holds congress on "Europe and globalisation" (To November 14). Contact: EPP (322) 285 41 57. Reuters Long-Term EU Diary (page 3/3 - Nov 13-Dec 31)
THURSDAY, NOVEMBER 13
BRUSSELS - EU industry ministers meet. No agenda yet available.
MONDAY, NOVEMBER 17
BRUSSELS - EU finance ministers meet. No agenda yet available.
BRUSSELS - EU agriculture ministers meet (To November 18). No agenda yet available.
STRASBOURG - European Parliament holds plenary session (To November 21).
WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 19
BRUSSELS - (possibly) EU fisheries ministers meet. No agenda yet available.
BRUSSELS - EU Committee of the Regions holds plenary session (To November 20).
THURSDAY, NOVEMBER 20
BRUSSELS - EU education ministers meet and hold structured dialogue with Central and East European countries. No agenda yet available.
MILAN - Third European conference for craft/trade and small businesses (To November 22). Contact: UEAPME (322) 230 7599.
FRIDAY, NOVEMBER 21
BRUSSELS - EU budget ministers meet. No agenda yet available.
MONDAY, NOVEMBER 24
BRUSSELS - EU foreign ministers meet (To November 25). No agenda yet available.
BRUSSELS - EU culture ministers meet. No agenda yet available.

LUXEMBOURG - The European Finance Convention and the Euro Week hold 11th annual convention (To November 28). Main topics discussed are the euro's impact on financial markets; European payment systems and implications for bank profitability; an overview of the enlargement programme - benefits and disadvantages of the first wave of entries. Speakers include: European Commission President Santer; Belgian Finance Minister Philippe Maystadt; European Commissioners Yves-Thibault de Silguy, Mario Monti, Monika Wulf-Mathies, Emma Bonino and Hans van den Broek; European Parliament deputy Karl Von Wogau; Bank of England Governor Eddie George; Spanish Foreign Minister Abel Matutes; Spanish Economy Minister Rodrigo de Rato; World Trade Organisation Director General Renato Ruggiero; French Economy Minister Jean Arthuis; European Investment Bank President Brian Unwin.
THURSDAY, NOVEMBER 27
BRUSSELS - EU internal market ministers meet. No agenda yet available.
FRIDAY, NOVEMBER 28
BRUSSELS - EU development ministers meet. No agenda yet available.
HELSINKI - Environment ministerial conference in the framework of the "Barcelona process" of cooperation between the European Union and 12 Mediterrean countries.
MONDAY, DECEMBER 1
BRUSSELS - EU finance ministers meet. No agenda yet available.
BRUSSELS - EU telecoms ministers meet. No agenda yet available.
LONDON - EU Committee of the Regions holds seminar on "Green paper on the citizens' network". European Commissioner Kinnock attends. Contact: Committee of the Regions (322) 282 2155.
TUESDAY, DECEMBER 2
BRUSSELS - EU social affairs ministers meet. No agenda yet available.
BRUSSELS - NATO defence ministers meet (To Dec 3).
WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 3
BRUSSELS - European Parliament holds mini session (To December 4). Provisional agenda includes debate on EU enlargement.
THURSDAY, DECEMBER 4
BRUSSELS - EU health ministers meet. No agenda yet available.
BRUSSELS - EU justice and home affairs ministers meet. No agenda yet available.

MONTEVIDEO - European Association of Chambers of Commerce (Eurochambres) sponsors a trade initiative bringing together some 200 EU companies and up to 300 companies from Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Paraguay and Uruguay (To December 5). Contact: Eurochambres (322) 282 0850.
MONDAY, DECEMBER 8
BRUSSELS - EU foreign ministers meet (To December 9). No agenda yet available.
BRUSSELS - EU energy ministers meet. No agenda yet available.
WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 10
BRUSSELS - EU transport ministers meet (To December 11). No agenda yet available.
BRUSSELS - EU Economic and Social Committee (ECOSOC) holds plenary session (To December 11).
FRIDAY, DECEMBER 12
LUXEMBOURG - Luxembourg presidency hosts European Council of heads of state and government (To December 13).
MONDAY, DECEMBER 15
BRUSSELS - EU agriculture ministers meet (To December 16). No agenda yet available.
STRASBOURG - European Parliament holds plenary session (To December 19).
TUESDAY, DECEMBER 16
BRUSSELS - EU environment ministers meet (To December 17). No agenda yet available.
BRUSSELS - NATO foreign ministers meet (To Dec 17).
WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 17
STRASBOURG - Presentation on the outcome of the Luxembourg EU presidency to the European Parliament.
THURSDAY, DECEMBER 18
BRUSSELS - EU fisheries ministers meet (To December 19). No agenda yet available.
LUXEMBOURG - Closing of the European Year Against Racism (To December 19).
MONDAY, DECEMBER 22
BRUSSELS - (possibly) EU finance ministers meet. No agenda yet available.
WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 24
- EU institutions closed for Christmas holidays until Sunday, January 4 inclusive.
BIRMINGHAM, United Kingdom - Group of Seven (G7) - Britain, U.S., Canada, France, Germany, Italy and Japan - hold summit.
